title: VidRouteBench: A Benchmark for Budgeted Video-Generation Routing
abstract: arXiv:2611.28099v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Text-to-video generators differ by two orders of magnitude in price, and a cheap configuration of a strong model is often good enough for a prompt. Routing prompts across such arms (model x sampling configuration) should buy quality at fixed budget, but no dataset supports studying it: public video-preference sets contain only closed models, one configuration each.   We release VidRouteBench: 16 arms from 7 open families spanning 121x in measured cost ($0.0025-$0.298 per clip), 27,110 clips (1,421 A800-hours) over 1,625 grouped prompts, a quality score frozen after calibration against human preferences (68.7% CV accuracy vs 66.2% for the best single scorer), per-clip scores on 9 identifiable quality dimensions, repeated seeds, an encrypted test split, and a sealed newest family for cold start. translated_title: VidRouteBench：面向预算约束视频生成路由的基准测试
translated_abstract: 文本到视频生成器的价格相差两个数量级，而强模型的一个廉价配置对于许多提示词而言往往已经足够好。在这些“臂”（模型×采样配置）之间路由提示词，应当能够在固定预算下换取更高质量的输出，但目前尚无数据集支持这一研究：公开的视频偏好数据集仅包含闭源模型，且每个模型只有一种配置。我们发布了VidRouteBench：包含来自7个开源模型家族的16个臂，实测成本跨度达121倍（每段视频0.0025至0.298美元）；涵盖1,625个分组提示词的27,110个视频片段（共1,421个A800 GPU小时）；一个基于人类偏好校准后冻结的质量评分（交叉验证准确率68.7%，高于最佳单一评分器的66.2%）；9个可识别质量维度上的逐片段评分；重复随机种子；加密的测试集划分；以及为冷启动评估密封保存的最新模型家族。其评估器将路由器与最优的提示词无关的臂组合进行比较，而非仅与最优单一臂比较。此处的每提示词专门化是真实的（原文摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 该论文发布了首个支持预算约束下视频生成路由研究的基准数据集VidRouteBench，包含7个开源家族的16种配置、27,110个视频片段及经人类偏好校准的质量评分，使在固定预算下通过提示词路由选择最优模型与采样配置成为可能。
en_tdlr: The paper releases VidRouteBench, the first benchmark for budgeted video-generation routing, featuring 16 arms from 7 open model families, 27,110 clips, and human-preference-calibrated quality scores, enabling routers to maximize generation quality at fixed budgets by selecting among models and sampling configurations.
